title: Four-dimensional geometry: measure, rotations, and finite-core contact
summary: A source-linked cumulative Meridian checkpoint covering four-dimensional solver representations, noncommuting SO(4) rotation closure, finite-core contact kernels, and Archimedean S3 integration, with numerical controls and explicit unresolved physics.
public_copy: Recent geometry controls expose three differences that matter for SAT/H(s)H reconstruction: rotations in four dimensions can leave an ordered residual after their nominal angles cancel; measuring the three-sphere by a continuum of tori requires the correct normal-spacing factor; and hard-core overlap is mathematically unlike smooth interactions at complete coincidence. These are reproducible tools and sandboxed tests, not a derived force or confirmation of the physical model.
